problem_title: Longest Substring of One Repeating Character
problem_statement: After each query replaces one character in s, return the longest contiguous run of one repeated character.
memory_hook: Segment Trees Connect Runs at Matching Boundaries!
intuition: Only runs touching the updated position can change. A segment tree lets us recompute only the affected ancestors.
approach: Each segment stores its length, boundary characters, uniform prefix and suffix lengths, and its best internal run. Merge the boundary runs only when their characters match.
node_fields: length: number of positions in the segment
prefix: longest uniform run from the left
suffix: longest uniform run from the right
best: longest uniform run anywhere in the segment
merge_rules: best = max(L.best, R.best, L.suffix + R.prefix if same)
prefix extends into R only when L is uniform and same is true
suffix extends into L only when R is uniform and same is true
examples: bbb | ccc -> crossing run is blocked because b != c
pseudocode:
merge(L, R):
  N.len = L.len + R.len
  N.prefix, N.suffix = L.prefix, R.suffix
  N.best = max(L.best, R.best)

  if L.rightChar == R.leftChar:
    N.best = max(N.best, L.suffix + R.prefix)
    if L.prefix == L.len:
      N.prefix = L.len + R.prefix
    if R.suffix == R.len:
      N.suffix = R.len + L.suffix
  return N
